refs: is there room in thy father’s house for us to lodge in?
And he lodged there that same night
We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in
Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem

POSSESS.title: Possess
refs: and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them
possess thou the west and the south
and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers
that they may dwell there, and have it in possession

FAST.title: Fast
refs: and chastened my soul with fasting
My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness
For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore

FILL.title: Fill
refs: and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink
and the country was filled with water
And they shall fill thy houses, and the houses of all thy servants
Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD

CAST.title: Cast
CAST.gkm: To take down, pull down, demolish.
refs: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself
Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee
Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you
Cast not away therefore your confidence

DWELL.title: Dwell
refs: and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God
thou that dwellest between the cherubims
dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob
If brethren dwell together, and one of them die

HEARKEN.title: Hearken
HEARKEN.gkm: To hear, listen, attend, perceive by hearing, comprehend by hearing.
refs: hear this: hearken to the voice of my words

ABIDE.title: Abide
ABIDE.hbm: To lodge, stop over, pass the night, abide.
refs: and Abidah, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah
Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not

RETURN.title: Return
refs: So Abraham returned unto his young men
From all places whence ye shall return unto us they will be upon you
For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time

PASS.title: Pass
PASS.gkm: To come into being, be born, arise, come on.
PASS.hbm: To be, become, come to pass, exist, happen, fall out.
refs: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land
till thy people pass over, O LORD
And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass
trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass

GUIDE.title: Guide
GUIDE.gkm: A leader on the way, a guide.
refs: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation
Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory
and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands

STAND.title: Stand
STAND.gkm: To make to stand, to place, set, set up, establish, appoint.
STAND.hbm: To stand, remain, endure, take one's stand.
refs: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door
and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir
And Elisha said, before whom I stand, surely

TAKE.title: Take
TAKE.gkm: To raise, take up, lift or draw up.
refs: and take a wife unto my son Isaac
sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina
take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus
Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man

COMFORT.title: Comfort
COMFORT.hbm: To be sorry, console oneself, repent, regret, comfort, be comforted.
refs: and Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death
and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted
and for comforters, but I found none
thy merciful kindness be for my comfort

REPAIR.title: Repair
REPAIR.gkm: To mend, restore, put in order; to make complete.
refs: Let them repair the breaches of the house
Thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths
In a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets
Ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness

ACKNOWLEDGE.title: Acknowledge
ACKNOWLEDGE.hbm: To recognise, acknowledge, know, respect, discern, regard.
refs: neither did he acknowledge his brethren

LABOUR.title: Labour
LABOUR.gkm: Hence, in LXX and NT, to work with effort, to toil.
refs: and their labour unto the locust
and let the strangers spoil his labour
For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands

WRITE.title: Write
refs: they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet
This shall be written for the generation to come
as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings
my tongue is the pen of a ready writer

BURN.title: Burn
refs: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering
The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate
God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering
with burnt offering and whole burnt offering

LAUGH.title: Laugh
LAUGH.hbm: To laugh, to rejoice, to play.
refs: God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me
Then was our mouth filled with laughter

SAVE.title: Save
SAVE.hbm: To save, be saved, be delivered.
refs: But thou hast saved us from our enemies
save thy servant that trusteth in thee
But thou hast saved us from our enemies
thou hast given commandment to save me

INCREASE.title: Increase
refs: and were increased greatly upon the earth
when the glory of his house is increased
Storehouses also for the increase of corn
and dost not increase thy wealth by their price

MAKE.title: Make
refs: and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God
And I will make my covenant between me and thee
and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures
for I will there make of thee a great nation

ACCEPT.title: Accept
ACCEPT.hbm: To be pleased with, to accept, delight in.

SOW.title: Sow
refs: Then Isaac sowed in that land
And sow the fields, and plant vineyards
that thou shalt sow the ground withal
Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart

ANOINT.title: Anoint
ANOINT.gkm: To anoint, festally or in homage.
ANOINT.hbm: To smear, anoint, spread a liquid.
refs: where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me
hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows
I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him

LEND.title: Lend
refs: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed
and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion

CHOOSE.title: Choose
CHOOSE.gkm: To choose, select, to pick out.
refs: the way that he shall choose
I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me

GAIN.title: Gain
GAIN.hbm: Profit, unjust gain, gain (profit) acquired by violence.

FEAST.title: Feast
refs: for we must hold a feast unto the LORD
and ye shall keep it a feast to the LORD throughout your generations
in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day

DESIRE.title: Desire
DESIRE.gkm: To will, be willing, wish, desire.
refs: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty
For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation
that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion
Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire

CEASE.title: Cease
CEASE.gkm: To make to cease, restrain, hinder.
refs: and day and night shall not cease
Thou hast made his glory to cease
He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth
cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us

CRY.title: Cry
CRY.hbm: To cry, cry out, call, call for help.
refs: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble
he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry
Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer

DEVISE.title: Devise
refs: And to devise curious works, to work in gold
He deviseth mischief upon his bed
and of those that devise cunning work
Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully

STRIVE.title: Strive
refs: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac’s herdmen
and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah

PRESS.title: Press
PRESS.gkm: To be by, at hand or present.
refs: then receive my present at my hand
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble
For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore
The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive

PREVAIL.title: Prevail
PREVAIL.hbm: To prevail, overcome, endure, have power, be able.
refs: and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali
And when he saw that he prevailed not against him
yet they have not prevailed against me

TELL.title: Tell
TELL.gkm: To pick out, gather, reckon, recount.
TELL.hbm: To be conspicuous, tell, make known.
refs: Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee
and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight
when he goeth abroad, he telleth it
we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks

RISE.title: Rise
RISE.hbm: To rise, arise, stand, rise up, stand up.
refs: Rise up, and get you forth from among my people
defend me from them that rise up against me
and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more
and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me

UNDERSTAND.title: Understand
refs: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this
Through thy precepts I get understanding
There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God
Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law

BRING.title: Bring
BRING.hbm: To go in, enter, come, go, come in.
refs: saying, If I bring him not unto thee
to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast
therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee
and God will shortly bring it to pass

PROSPER.title: Prosper
PROSPER.hbm: To advance, prosper, make progress, succeed, be profitable.
refs: will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way
And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man
seeing the LORD hath prospered my way
fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way

ENTER.title: Enter
ENTER.hbm: To go in, enter, come, go, come in.
refs: and he entered into his chamber, and wept there
Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest
and entered into Judah, and encamped against the fenced cities
He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins

THANK.title: Thank
THANK.gkm: To be thankful, give thanks (chiefly in late writers and Inscr.
refs: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD
O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good
O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name
O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever

THIRST.title: Thirst
refs: And the people thirsted there for water
and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink
the wild asses quench their thirst

TOUCH.title: Touch
refs: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her
he touched the hollow of his thigh
That thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee
Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm

KNOCK.title: Knock
KNOCK.gkm: To knock, to rap at a door.
KNOCK.hbm: To knock, to beat, to rap.
refs: knock, and it shall be opened
knock, and it shall be opened

MEET.title: Meet
refs: And the servant ran to meet her, and said
and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him
and Leah went out to meet him, and said
and went up to meet Israel his father

TRAIN.title: Train
TRAIN.hbm: Trained, instructed, trained servant, tried, experienced.

DRAW.title: Draw
refs: Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families

LEAD.title: Lead
refs: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
lead me to the rock that is higher than I
and lead me in the way everlasting

CONSUME.title: Consume
refs: for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way
Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul
they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away
For my days are consumed like smoke

BREATHE.title: Breathe
BREATHE.gkm: To breathe upon, to breathe into.
BREATHE.hbm: Breath, breath of life; the spirit of life.
refs: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD

OBEY.title: Obey
refs: because thou hast obeyed my voice
And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother
obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went
Because that Abraham obeyed my voice

SHINE.title: Shine
SHINE.hbm: To be or become light, shine.
refs: and cause his face to shine upon us
cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved
and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved
Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes

VOW.title: Vow
refs: and where thou vowedst a vow unto me
that I may daily perform my vows
For thou, O God, hast heard my vows
I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people

OVERTAKE.title: Overtake
OVERTAKE.hbm: To reach, overtake, take hold upon.
refs: and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them
I will overtake, I will divide the spoil

LISTEN.title: Listen
LISTEN.gkm: To hear, to listen, to heed.
LISTEN.hbm: To hear, to listen, to obey.
refs: Blessed is the man that heareth me

RECEIVE.title: Receive
refs: then receive my present at my hand
for he shall receive me. Selah
or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received
Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed

OBSERVE.title: Observe
OBSERVE.gkm: To watch over, guard, keep, preserve.
OBSERVE.hbm: To keep, guard, observe, give heed.
refs: And ye shall observe the feast of unleavened bread
That they might observe his statutes
for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant
I shall observe it with my whole heart

EXALT.title: Exalt
EXALT.hbm: To rise, rise up, be high, be lofty, be exalted.
refs: and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land
and in my name shall his horn be exalted
Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted
but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted

HONOUR.title: Honour
refs: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour
his horn shall be exalted with honour
Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious
Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious

FLEE.title: Flee
refs: And of every living thing of all flesh
And they shall eat the flesh in that night
There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger
for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee

MARVEL.title: Marvel
refs: and the men marvelled one at another

HONOR.title: Honor
HONOR.gkm: To honor, value, to esteem, prize.
HONOR.hbm: To honor, glorify; to be weighty.
refs: Honour thy father and thy mother
them that honour me I will honour
Honour the LORD with thy substance

RULE.title: Rule
refs: and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee
Thou rulest the raging of the sea
that ruled over all that he had, Put
He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance

STRENGTHEN.title: Strengthen
STRENGTHEN.gkm: To fix, set fast, make fast.
refs: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed
and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed
Also he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken
For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates

CLEAVE.title: Cleave
refs: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat
I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me
our belly cleaveth unto the earth
My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word

SUSTAIN.title: Sustain
refs: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee

LOOSE.title: Loose
refs: and loose his shoe from off his foot
to loose those that are appointed to death
The house of him that hath his shoe loosed
and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds

REDEEM.title: Redeem
refs: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed
and the high God their redeemer
He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence
and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy

ENJOY.title: Enjoy
ENJOY.gkm: To enjoy, to benefit, to take pleasure.
ENJOY.hbm: To rejoice, be glad, to take delight.
refs: the joy of the LORD is your strength

CARE.title: Care
CARE.hbm: To lift, bear up, carry, take.
refs: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father
And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi
Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry
carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight

GROW.title: Grow
GROW.hbm: To grow, become great, to magnify.
refs: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon
he shall grow as the lily
grow up as calves of the stall

STAY.title: Stay
STAY.hbm: To lean on, trust in, support.
refs: and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon

STUDY.title: Study
STUDY.gkm: To love or seek after honour, hence, to be ambitious, emulous.

EAT.title: Eat
EAT.hbm: To eat, devour, burn up, feed.
refs: and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life
save that which every man must eat
Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank
Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water

DIVIDE.title: Divide
DIVIDE.hbm: To divide, share, plunder, allot, apportion, assign.
refs: I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them
and she that tarried at home divided the spoil
I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth
I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth
